Subject: Listing on CloudLedger marketplace — partner paper + pass-through items

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. CloudLedger is ready to move forward with Redwood for a marketplace listing. Procurement asked that we share the standard partner paper and marketplace addendum so Redwood can confirm acceptance of the marketplace billing pass-through and metering terms.

Key asks from our side:
- Standard marketplace addendum (we pass through marketplace fees to sellers; sellers accept pass-through invoicing).
- Order form will reference marketplace metering (per-seat + per-API-call) and CloudLedger will invoice customers; CloudLedger then remits to Redwood per the orderform waterfall.
- Audit right for CloudLedger (standard) to validate usage numbers tied to remittance.

Attaching: partner_paper_draft.pdf; marketplace_addendum_v1.docx.

Can you confirm who on Redwood legal/ops should review? We want to keep momentum and aim to finalize commercial terms this quarter.

Best,
Anna Morozov
Head of Partnerships, CloudLedger
[sales@cloudledger.com]
[attachment: partner_paper_draft.pdf (95 KB)]
[attachment: marketplace_addendum_v1.docx (48 KB)]

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: CloudLedger Sales <sales@cloudledger.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2027-03-11T08:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Listing on CloudLedger marketplace — partner paper + pass-through items

Anna — thanks for sending. Looping in Ben (Commercial) and Laura (Legal Ops).

High-level comments from our side before we redact formal redlines:
- We can accept marketplace pass-through for third-party marketplace fees, but we need:
  - A cap or a predictable bucketing approach (so pass-through charges don’t create open-ended exposure).
  - Clear audit timing and scope (90 days notice for any audit, sampling limited to 1 year).
  - Order form must clearly state invoicing waterfall and that CloudLedger is the primary biller to end-customers.
- For the MSA: Redwood needs an indemnity carveout for mis-metering and a clause requiring CloudLedger to provide monthly metering statements that match the invoices.

I’ve attached our initial redlines to the MSA and a spreadsheet mapping the order form itemization to Redwood's revenue recognition groups. Please review and revert with CloudLedger's legal.

Attachments: redlined_MSA_v3.docx; marketplace_addendum_comments.xlsx

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of GTM Partnerships, Redwood Inference
[kimberly_park@redwood.com]
[attachment: redlined_MSA_v3.docx (22 KB)]
[attachment: marketplace_addendum_comments.xlsx (12 KB)]

Date: 2027-03-11T10:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Listing on CloudLedger marketplace — pass-through invoicing flow

Quick clarification from Commercial:
- We can accept pass-through but need to avoid retroactive adjustments beyond 60 days. If CloudLedger changes metering or fees, those should be prospective except for clear invoice errors.
- Proposed addition to addendum: a monthly reconciliation file due within 15 days of month close; disputes to be escalated within 30 days.

I attached a clean orderform template with placeholders for the CloudLedger waterfall and suggested invoicing language.

Ben Carter
Senior Dir, Commercial Partnerships, Redwood Inference
[attachment: orderform_CloudLedger_2027.pdf (34 KB)]

From: Anna Morozov <anna@cloudledger.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: CloudLedger Procurement <procurement@cloudledger.com>
Date: 2027-03-12T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Listing on CloudLedger marketplace — pass-through invoicing flow

Thanks Kimberly and Ben — appreciate the detailed notes. Our legal team reviewed your redlines and propose the following:
- We can include a 12-month lookback audit right (instead of sampling) but request that audits be executed by a mutually agreed auditor and limited to two events per year.
- Retro billing: we will accept the 60-day cap for adjustments, but any change to CloudLedger's published marketplace fee (e.g., platform fee increases) will be applied per the marketplace notice policy and will be prospectively invoiced.
- CloudLedger cannot accept a blanket indemnity carveout for mis-metering, but we will accept a requirement to provide detailed metering files and to remediate confirmed errors with refunds or credits.

Attached: CLD_redlines_marketable.pdf. We flagged a few orderform language items that are non-negotiable for our procurement team.

Can we set a short call tomorrow to resolve the remaining items?

Best,
Anna Morozov
Head of Partnerships, CloudLedger
[attachment: CLD_redlines_marketable.pdf (58 KB)]

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: anna@cloudledger.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2027-03-13T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Listing on CloudLedger marketplace — pass-through invoicing flow

Anna — thanks for the quick turnaround. I’ve looped in Rishi (Finance) for a quick decision on whether Redwood can accept the remediation approach (credits/refunds) rather than a carveout. Rishi — we’re seeing two sticking points from CloudLedger legal: limited audit scope and refusal to accept mis-metering indemnity carveout. Commercial (Ben) is OK on the invoicing windows, but Finance needs a reinsurable path.

Rishi — can you confirm if Redwood is comfortable proceeding with:
- 60-day adjustment window,
- Required monthly reconciliation file,
- CloudLedger remediation via credits/refunds (subject to dispute process), and
- A cap on pass-through exposure (we suggest 7% of monthly recognized revenue or $25k/month, whichever is lower).

If Finance signs off, we’ll propose final language and route to DocuSign.

Thanks,
Kimberly

Subject: Re: Listing on CloudLedger marketplace — pass-through invoicing flow

Kimberly/Ben/Laura — reviewed. Finance is OK to proceed on the following negotiated guardrails:
- Accept remediation via credits/refunds (no indemnity carveout) provided CloudLedger provides monthly reconciliation files within 15 days of month close and agrees to a 60-day adjustment window.
- Cap pass-through exposure to the greater of $25,000/month or 7% of recognized monthly revenue for the customer group covered on the order form (documented in the marketplace addendum).
- Audit limited to 12 months of lookback and no more than two audits per 12-month period; auditor must be mutually agreed.

Please update the marketplace addendum with the cap language and the reconciliation cadence. Once CloudLedger confirms, Legal Ops (Laura) will prepare the final MSA/order form for signature and send the DocuSign envelope.

Rishi Malhotra
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference
